description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_EN: Some HSR trains will not stop at Humen Station
description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_CN: 高鐵個別列車車次不停虎門站

2026-11-21T16:06:00.CONTENT_EN: As informed by the Chinese Mainland Railway Authorities, the following trains will not stop at Humen Station between 24 November and 27 December because of scheduling arrangements. Ticket sales to and from Humen Station are suspended for these trips. From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station G388, G904, G928, G6048/5, G6508, G6516, G6530, G6534, G6536, G6538, G6580 To Hong Kong West Kowloon Station G6046/7, G6511, G6515, G6517, G6527, G6529, G6531, G6533, G6539 For the latest arrangement, please refer to the 12306 official website or mobile app, or the High Speed Rail website or mobile app.
2026-11-21T16:06:00.CONTENT_CN: 中國內地鐵路部門通知，因應列車調度安排，11月24日至12月27日期間，以下車次不停虎門站，並暫停發售來往虎門的車票。 由香港西九龍站出發 G388，G904，G928，G6048/5，G6508，G6516，G6530，G6534，G6536，G6538，G6580 前往香港西九龍站 G6046/7，G6511，G6515，G6517，G6527，G6529，G6531，G6533，G6539 最新安排請瀏覽12306官方網站及手機應用程式、高速鐵路網頁及手機應用程式。

2026-11-22T15:21:00.CONTENT_EN: All car parks at West Kowloon Cultural District are full. Members of the public are encouraged to take public transport to the West Kowloon Cultural District.
2026-11-22T15:21:00.CONTENT_CN: 西九文化區內所有停車場現已泊滿車輛，前往西九文化區一帶的市民請使用公共交通工具。

2026-11-24T08:45:00.CONTENT_EN: Due to high wind , the following special traffic and transport arrangements have been implemented on Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Link Road (HZMB HKLR), with details as shown below: The speed limit of the HZMB HKLR is lowered from 100 km/h to 50 km/h.
2026-11-24T08:45:00.CONTENT_CN: 由於強風，港珠澳大橋香港連接路已實施以下特別交通及運輸安排： 港珠澳大橋香港連接路的最高車速限制由每小時100 公里降低至每小時50 公里。
